title: Eight messages that named a cause nobody measured, and the guard that bricked the Queen's own chat
problem: The delegation chain reported a busy, healthy swarm while the board had not moved in five hours, and the Queen had been unable to write a single line of her own transcript for a month. Neither was visible from any message the system printed, because the messages named causes the code had no way to observe.
root_cause: One defect class, eight instances. A function knows a fact (a value is empty, a list is short, a fetch returned nothing) and the message states a REASON for that fact which was never measured. Two of the eight were guards that outlived their purpose: the conversation write-refusal protected the bytes, kept refusing after the bytes were safely quarantined, and so bricked the slot; the Keychain cooldown existed to stop callers piling up and instead latched for the life of the process.
findings: ChatConversation.trinityQueenId is E621E1F8-C36C-495A-93FC-0C247A3E6E5F, and it is one of the sixteen conversations made undecryptable by the 25-27 July key overwrite. ConversationPersister.save refused every write to it: 92 refusals in one five-hour window, each a delegation note or review verdict dropped in silence.

queen.choose.already_running printed 'a worker already has it' for every state in `spokenFor` - queued, running, awaitingReview, rejected, accepted, merged. The release registry held zero running tasks (17 cancelled, 12 failed, 11 accepted, 5 awaitingReview, 3 merged), so all 8 such lines per tick were false.
The board was 100% exhausted: 68 ticks, 68 `queen.choose.exhausted`. 12 of 23 candidates blocked by two awaitingReview tasks aged 37h and 39h.

~/.trios/config.json holds both provider keys with zero-length values - it reads as configured to anyone who opens it and supplies nothing to any consumer. The Keychain has been the only working release source and nobody knew.
The release binary was built at 09:11 while the last two commits landed at 09:23 and 09:26, so the 'refuses to orphan working bees' fix existed in git and in no running process.

`make check` was red on arrival for reasons predating this round: make-dollars flagged $(HOME) and $(FORCE), two correct Make variables missing from MAKE_DOLLAR_VARS, which failed check-selftest's clean-fixture half.
fix: ConversationPersister.save now gates the refusal on quarantineHolds(id) - a byte-for-byte comparison between what is in the slot right now and what is under the quarantine key - and reclaims the slot when the bytes are provably elsewhere. QueenDelegationPolicy.spokenForReport(states:) returns the bucket and sentence for a spoken-for candidate, so the tick cannot claim a worker where DelegatedTaskState says there is none. MAKE_DOLLAR_VARS gained HOME and FORCE.
prevention: Before committing any warn/error/refusal string, answer in one line: which statement in this function established that? If the answer is 'it is usually that', measure it or say less.
Keep the state, not the boolean. A Set<Int> of issue numbers cannot report why; a [Int: [State]] makes the false sentence impossible to write.
When a guard produces a bad outcome, ask what it protects and whether that thing is already safe by other means. Gate on the condition measured now, not on a flag recording that it was once true.

Distinguish empty from absent. This project has hit the same distinction four times: nil vs 0 file count, nonexistent branch vs branch with no commits, empty config value vs missing key, unreadable conversation vs empty one.
Run `make check` at the START of a round. Twice it was red on arrival, and the second time cost a debugging pass on an innocent change.
Compare the binary's mtime against the newest commit before believing any live observation.
corrections_to_earlier_claims: I wrote in a commit message that DEV reads its key from ~/.trios/config.json. It does not - it reads ~/.trios-dev/secrets/. The generalisation from dev to release was made without opening the file.
I reported 'the swarm is stopped' eleven times. That was true of release and false of dev the whole time. When a symptom is environmental, check whether it is variant-specific before generalising.
